name: com.gamecore.reference-conformance
description: GC-024's reference-conformance fixtures: every before/after assembly-operation table of docs/game-core/07-reference-compositions.md transcribed as data (cards section 2.4, narrative section 3.3, traversal section 4.3, cross-family section 5), the ordered script each table is executed through in a real world, the canonical normalised trace document a run records, the oracle that compares a trace against the transcribed table, and the pure-rule projections that prove each transcribed number agrees with the gameplay rules packages. Unity-free by design so the same fixtures run in plain dotnet, in Unity EditMode and in the qualification player.
